**Big but shallow. 1291 hits, 94 files.** Most is a mechanical rename inside `services`.

Four zones must keep `account_id`:

| Zone | Why |
|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml:16) | Public contract, frozen |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | Wire key, frozen |
| `migrations/*.sql` | Applied history, 12 files |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | Generated, gets overwritten |

The DB column stays too. 125 hits live inside SQL strings.

Sign off on `services` only.
